bindings.label: Patient presented with abdominal pain and bloating

54-year-old Caucasian male with history of hypertension, Raynaud’s syndrome, rectal cancer in remission post-surgical resection and radiation therapy, and ongoing radiation-induced cystitis; he had been using nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) for abdominal pain and bloating

Two months prior, diagnosed with strongly positive anti-RNA polymerase III systemic sclerosis following onset of dysphagia; prescribed methotrexate (MTX) up to 20 mg weekly; had not taken MTX for 14 days due to feeling unwell
Examination revealed a small bladder rupture attributed to cystitis, which did not necessitate surgical intervention
During bladder evaluation, abnormal serum sodium and creatinine levels were detected, leading to further cardiac assessment
